newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's shrs up on renewed takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's shrs up on renewed takeover talk.

text.p: Harrah's Entertainment Inc shares rose 1-1/4 to 19-3/8 in Friday afternoon trading on renewed talk the gambling company is an acquisition target of ITT Corp as it attempts to defend against the $6.5 billion bid from Hilton Hotels Corp.
Business Week magazine, in its current edition, quotes unnamed sources as saying ITT may seek to acquire Harrah's for $35 a share plus debt assumption.
A Harrah's spokesman said the company "doesn't respond to rumors or speculation."

An ITT spokesman was not immediately available, and Hilton's Marc Grossman, senior vice president corporate affairs said, "it's just a rumor and we are not going to react to every rumor that comes up."

Indeed, Harrah's has long been an acquisition candidate because its stock is undervalued relative to competitors, analysts said. Its shares traded in the mid-30's back in mid-1996 when it began warning of earnings shortfalls.
"Harrah's is trading at such an incredibly cheap price that its going to be on anybody's consolidation screen," said Jeff Logsdon, analyst at Cruttenden Roth.
